extracted.intended_audience: IP professionals (patent attorneys/agents), corporate IP managers, AIPLA members, and researchers/analysts interested in IP practice economics
extracted.subtask_description: Extraction of survey variables and reported metrics from the AIPLA Report of the Economic Survey 2023 describing income, time allocation, budgeting, billing, and practice demographics for corporate and private-firm IP practitioners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Percent of annual corporate IP budget devoted to the following types of work (Q29)
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent of annual corporate IP budget allocated across specified in-house functions and outside counsel fees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Survey lists many sub-items reported as Mean (Average) by technology focus: In house staff to perform/manage IP prosecution work; In house staff to provide opinions or counseling prior to litigation or formal ADR; In house staff to perform IP licensing; In house staff to perform non-licensing transactional work; In house staff to perform IP litigation; In house staff to perform post-grant proceedings; In house staff to perform other dispute resolution; Fees paid to outside counsel to perform IP prosecution; Fees paid to outside counsel to perform opinions/counseling prior to litigation or formal ADR; Fees paid to outside counsel to perform non-licensing transactional work; Fees paid to outside counsel to perform IP licensing; Fees paid to outside counsel to perform IP litigation; Fees paid to outside counsel to perform post-grant proceedings; Fees paid to outside counsel to perform other dispute resolution; Supervision and training of attorneys or agents within your organization; Participation in bar association or professional association activities; Office management and administration; Pro bono work; Other. Reported statistics include means by tech focus group (Biotech, Chemical, Computer Software, Mechanical, Medical/Health Care, Other) and total.

rubrics_metrics.name: Respondent background / demographics (Background Information)
rubrics_metrics.description: Basic respondent characteristics collected in the survey.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit items shown include: Admitted to the Patent Bar - Yes/No; Age; Gender (Male / Female / Prefer not to respond); Ethnicity (White/Caucasian, Black/African American, Hispanic/Latino, Asian/Pacific Islander, Prefer not to respond, Other); IP non-attorney experience (years); IP attorney experience (years); Highest education other than Law (Bachelor's, Master's, Doctorate). Reported as counts, percentages, and mean years where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total Gross Income for 2022 from your primary practice - Full-time Only (Q13a)
rubrics_metrics.description: Total gross income in calendar year 2022 from primary practice for full-time respondents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported with First Quartile (25%), Median (Midpoint), Third Quartile (75%), Mean (Average), and Number of Individuals. Breakouts provided by Years of IP law experience, Location (CMSA regions), IP technical specialization, Age, Gender, Highest non-law degree, Ethnicity, and full-time IP lawyers/agents in firm or corporation (firm size).

rubrics_metrics.name: Total Gross Income for 2022 by Type of Work (Q13a)
rubrics_metrics.description: Total gross income in 2022 segmented by respondents' primary type of work (>=50% of time).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples in report: IP prosecution work; Managing outside counsel for IP prosecution work. Reported using quartiles, median, mean and number of individuals for each work-type subgroup.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total Gross Income for 2022 by Number of Subordinates (Q13a)
rubrics_metrics.description: Total gross income in 2022 broken down by how many IP lawyers and patent agents report to the respondent (None, 1-5, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported with quartiles, median, mean and subgroup counts to show relationship between income and supervisory responsibilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amount of year-end cash bonus (Q13b)
rubrics_metrics.description: Year-end cash bonus amounts received in 2022 by respondents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported as First Quartile (25%), Median, Third Quartile (75%), Mean (Average) and number of individuals. Breakouts shown by years of experience, location, specialization, age, gender, non-law degree, ethnicity, firm size, etc.

rubrics_metrics.name: Employer's 2022 contribution to 401(k)/403(b) retirement and savings plans (Q14)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported as First Quartile (25%), Median, Third Quartile (75%), Mean and number of individuals; subgroup breakdowns by experience, location, specialization, age, gender, education, ethnicity, and firm staffing levels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expected total cash income for 2023 - Full-time Only (Q15)
rubrics_metrics.description: Respondent expectations for total cash income in 2023.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported with First Quartile, Median, Third Quartile, Mean and counts, and shown by subgroup (experience, location, specialization, age, gender, education, ethnicity, firm size).

rubrics_metrics.name: Percent of time devoted to the following types of work (Q18)
rubrics_metrics.description: How respondents allocate their working time across professional activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sub-items (reported as Mean/Average): IP prosecution work; Opinions or counseling prior to litigation or formal ADR; IP licensing; Non-licensing transactional work; IP litigation; Post-grant proceedings; Other dispute resolution; Supervision and training of other attorneys or agents within your organization; Office management and administration; Marketing/Business Development; Participation in bar/professional association activities; Managing outside counsel for IP prosecution work; Managing outside counsel for IP litigation work; Non-IP legal; Pro bono work; Other. Breakdowns by income level and other demographics are provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Percent of time devoted to the following IP areas (Q16)
rubrics_metrics.description: Share of time respondents spend on specific IP practice areas.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported as Mean/Average for areas: Business Law; Copyrights; Foreign IP Law; General IP; Patents; Trade Secrets; Trademarks; Privacy/Cyber-security; Other areas. Shown with subgrouping by income levels and counts.

rubrics_metrics.name: New priority US and PCT patent applications prepared and filed by you in 2022 (Q20)
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of new priority US and PCT patent applications the respondent prepared and filed in 2022.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported using First Quartile (25%), Median, Third Quartile (75%), Mean (Average) and number of individuals; subgroup breakdowns by location, technical specialization, firm staffing levels, etc.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct and indirect reports (Q21)
rubrics_metrics.description: How many IP lawyers and patent agents report to the respondent, directly or indirectly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Categorical counts shown (None, 1-5, 6-10, etc.) with percentages and total number of respondents in each category.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technology focus of company or business unit (Q28)
rubrics_metrics.description: Primary technology focus of respondent's corporation or business unit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Categorical options reported with counts/percentages: Biotech, Chemical, Electrical, Computer Software, Computer Hardware, Mechanical, Medical/Health Care, Pharmaceutical, Other.

rubrics_metrics.name: Billable hours recorded in 2022 (Q32)
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of billable hours respondents recorded in 2022.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported as First Quartile, Median, Mean and Third Quartile; subgrouped by location, IP technical specialization, age, gender, degree and firm size.

rubrics_metrics.name: Average hourly billing rate in 2022 (Q33)
rubrics_metrics.description: Average hourly billing rate charged by the respondent in 2022.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported as First Quartile, Median, Mean and Third Quartile; subgrouped by location, technical specialization, age, gender, education, ethnicity and firm size.

rubrics_metrics.name: Percent of services in 2022 billed (or will be billed) by type of basis (Q31)
rubrics_metrics.description: Billing basis mix for services during 2022.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Categories and reported Means: Hourly Billing; Predetermined Fee; Contingent Fee; Other Basis. Shown with subgroup breakdowns (location, specialization, age, gender, degree, ethnicity) and counts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Practice-role specific aggregates (Corporate IP Attorney/Agent, Private Firm Agent)
rubrics_metrics.description: Role-specific reported metrics aggregated separately for Corporate IP Head, Corporate IP Attorney, Corporate IP Agent, Private Firm Agent, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each role section repeats many of the above variables (income, bonuses, retirement contributions, expected income, time allocation, new patent applications, billing, billable hours, hourly rates, percent billed by basis, demographics). The report provides role-specific quartiles, means, medians and subgroup breakdowns for comparative analysis across practice roles.
